content_of_post_to_comment: I’ve read so many mediocre books lately. I want your book recommendation, but nothing merely nice or good. I want to know the single best book you’ve ever read in your life. Go.
comment: The “best book” question is tricky because the answer often changes with the reader. A masterpiece at 20 can feel ordinary at 40. Maybe the better test is: which book permanently altered how you see?
